summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor and set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with the required Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch after ERASE_IN_LINE that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed under Unreleased with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests were added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py as specified. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so all verification was by reading the code.
